content:
Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break is getting you ready for the weekend with AirPods Pro 3 still on sale and now at up to 25% off, plus we are also seeing AirPods Max 2 return to sale in all colors at $100 off. On top of those deals, Apple Watch Series 11 models are up to $172 off, rare discounts on official Apple Nike Watch bands, FREE $25 Best Buy gift card with MacBook Neo (or up to $120 off via the official Apple Refurbished Store), and this M5 Pro MacBook Pro still at $500 off ($100 below original MSRP). This week's Anker charging accessories deals start from $9, right here; plus LG's UltraFine 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor is $2,200 less than the Apple Studio Display XDR, don't miss it. See below for more details.

Hello everyone! AirPods Pro 3 are on sale again at nearly 25% off, one of the best deals this year

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 (with Active Noise Cancellation) $149 (originally $179)
  • AirPods 4 (with Active Noise Cancellation) $119 (originally $179 new) – Renewed Premium

Apple Refurbished 14-inch MacBook Pro

The cheapest M5 MacBook Pro currently available has just dropped to $1,439 at the Apple Ref store — this price is absolutely one of the lowest we've tracked on M5 models recently.

The official Apple Refurbished Store is currently selling the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD for $1,439 with free shipping.

This deal may not last long, so keep an eye out.

This unique M5 MacBook Pro configuration was discontinued from Apple's official lineup after the company boosted base storage to 1TB and launched the 2026 M5 Pro/M5 Max models. In other words, what you're seeing now is the cheapest M5 MacBook Pro, and it's unlikely you'll be able to grab one at this discounted price anytime soon.

Apple Watch Series 11 models are up to $172 off during this weekend's Apple shopping event

Amazon is still running a $100 off deal on the base model Apple Watch Series 11, starting from $299. While Best Buy has kicked off its weekend Apple sale, we wanted to specifically highlight Amazon's special deal on the Series 11 Cell model, hitting an all-time low and even cheaper than Best Buy — $172 off.

Amazon is currently selling the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell with Space Gray case for $327 with free shipping.

This configuration, originally priced at $499, is marked down by $172 — the lowest price we've tracked for this model on Amazon.

Similarly, you'll find deals on all 42mm and 46mm Cell models at Best Buy, starting from $399 — many 46mm configurations are already sold out on Amazon.

However, if you're not interested in the always-connected Cell version, the base Series 11 models are even cheaper right now, with both case sizes $100 off.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

Those looking for Apple Watch Ultra 3 deals should head to Amazon, as some models are now priced significantly lower than Best Buy:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $670 (originally $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)

Official Apple Nike Watch bands see rare 20% discount, some selling out soon

Beyond the further AirPods Pro 3 discount and a range of notable Apple Watch deals, this week's 4-day Apple shopping event is also bringing a rare 20% off on official Apple and Nike Sport Loops and Bands.

Amazon has already started some of the deals, but for Nike styles you'll need to head to Best Buy for 20% off (see image above):

  • Apple – 46mm Nike Sport Loop – Veiled Grey $39 (originally $49)
  • Apple – 42mm Nike Sport Band – Alpenglow Pink $39 (originally $49)
  • Apple – 46mm Sport Loop – Forest $39 (originally $49)
  • Apple – 46mm Sport Loop – Blue Mist $39 (originally $49)
  • And more…

Stock here will sell out fast, so you'll want to act quickly, and keep an eye out for the rare 20% off deal on the new Black Apple Sport Loop spotted on Amazon this morning.

Buy MacBook Neo and get a FREE $25 Best Buy gift card, or save $120 via the official Apple Refurbished Store

No matter how pricing shifts, deals on the MacBook Neo have always been scarce. Although the price of this machine has been hiked, it remains the cheapest new-generation MacBook you can buy right now, and there are several ways to save — Best Buy is offering a FREE $25 gift card on new units during the latest Apple shopping event, while the Apple Certified Refurbished Store offers up to $120 off.

Best Buy kicked off its massive 4-day Apple shopping event yesterday, and while some products are cheaper on Amazon, they currently have the best deal on the new MacBook Neo:

  • MacBook Neo + FREE $25 Best Buy gift card from $699

However, if you want the absolute lowest price, you'll want to check the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store. These machines have just had their prices hiked, but if you want the best price on one, this is the place:

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (originally $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (originally $799 new)

The 256GB model has clearly just reverted back to its old MSRP, and the 512GB is $20 below its old pricing, but that's just the reality — the price adjustment won't change anytime soon.

More of this week's best Apple deals, including one of the best prices on AirPods Pro 3, can be found below:

Rare Amazon deal drops the new Black Apple Sport Band to $39, more from $15

Reminder: Amazon Apple Watch Ultra 3 prices are far lower than today's Best Buy discounts, up to $130 off

Reserve iPhone 18 via Best Buy Apple gift card deal to enjoy savings

This new M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $500 off, $100 below pre-hike MSRP, and even cheaper than the Apple Refurbished Store

While many current MacBook Pro deals are essentially just rolling prices back to pre-hike MSRP, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is also offering decent markdowns. But this ongoing Amazon markdown on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro 2TB model is even better — $500 off the new MSRP, an additional $100 below the previously lower pricing.

Amazon is still selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB internal storage for $2,499 with free shipping.

Of course it's not exactly cheap, but the new pricing represents a $500 discount, and most notably is $100 cheaper than Apple's pre-hike MSRP.

Another notable comparison is the official Apple Refurbished Store, which sells the same refurbished unit for $50 more than Amazon.

Nobody likes price hikes, and this deal is admittedly a bit bittersweet, but that's just the reality — the discount is indeed deep, and even lower than the original MSRP.

However, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is also running decent markdowns right now, covering lower-priced models including the cheapest MacBook Neo from reliable sources, among others:

  • Apple Refurbished 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • Apple Refurbished 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (originally $1,599 new) – $240 off
  • Apple Refurbished 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new) – $300 off
  • Apple Refurbished 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new)

David Pogue's "Apple: The First 50 Years" hardcover book now just $26 on Amazon (originally $50)

Skip the Apple premium and grab the LG UltraFine 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor for $2,200 less than the Studio Display XDR (new low)

Sony XM6 ANC headphones see massive $230 discount, while supplies last

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • Sharge Mini portable charger with star-track LED lights now down to $35 (originally $50)
  • Grab an AOC 16-inch USB-C monitor for $60 to build a portable office
  • DOCKCASE SSD enclosure displays drive health with power-loss protection — now just $30 (all-time low)
  • EPOMAKER Glyph keyboard adds retro style to your desk, today $109
  • Baseus 70W 3-port charger with FREE 100W LED cable just $27 (51% off)
  • August Anker charging accessories deals start from $9: Smart Display chargers, cables, and more

All colors of AirPods Max 2 are $100 off during this week's 4-day Apple sale

While Amazon has further discounted AirPods Pro 3 as part of this week's Apple sale event, the $100 discount on Apple's latest AirPods Max 2 still stands.

Amazon is currently selling all five colors of the Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2 headphones for $449 with free shipping.

Originally $549, now $100 off — the lowest price we can find.

This weekend's deals carry over from Black Friday and July markdowns. While some colors briefly crept back up earlier, all are now $100 off again.

Aside from the late June Prime Day discount, we've never seen Apple's new-generation AirPods Max 2 priced lower than today — otherwise it's the lowest price Amazon has tracked since its earlier launch this year.

All iPhone Air models are $149 off, or up to $286 off open-box at Best Buy (matching all-time lows)

As AirPods Pro 3 drop further to nearly 25% off to see us into the weekend, both Best Buy and Amazon are running massive Apple sales. One highlight is a straight $149 off all new, unlocked iPhone Air models, plus up to $286 off open-box units. Details below.

Best Buy has now brought back the all-time low prices on all iPhone Air models, including all four colors of the 256GB, 512GB, and 1TB versions, starting from $849.99 with free shipping:

  • iPhone Air 256GB $850 (originally $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB $1,050 (originally $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB $1,250 (originally $1,400)

These are new, unlocked models, with prices matching the lowest we've tracked from reliable sources. Amazon does not officially sell new iPhone Air listings.

Best Buy is also offering solid "Excellent" condition open-box units at even lower prices — a few standout deals are listed below, but you can browse all open-box listings via the "More Options" link on each model page.

  • Open-box iPhone Air 256GB Space Black $807 (originally $999)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Sky Blue $913 (originally $1,199)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Space Black $978 (originally $1,199)
